no_brows.add: No eyebrows. Eyebrows are a later piece.

no_nose.add: No nose. The nose is a later piece.

no_mouth.add: No mouth and no lips. The mouth is a later piece.

no_hair.add: Bald. No hair and no circlet.

no_cloth.add: No neckband, no cloth, no armor, no pants, and no boots.
no_cloth.negative: neckband, scarf, scarf tail, hanging cloth, armor, pants, boots

feet.add: Two distinct feet, not blocks or slabs.

arms.add: Two arms a little away from the torso.
arms.negative: missing arm, extra arm, fused arm

mannequin-front.about: Front of the clean base body for a customizable player. Eyes may stay. Eyebrows, the nose, and the mouth are later pieces.
mannequin-front.allow: Eyes may be present. A bald head and bare skin are correct. Do not fail those.

checks.fail_if: There is not exactly one full-body person, standing, facing the camera.
Eyebrows are drawn. Eyebrows are a later customization.
A nose is drawn. The nose is a later customization.
A mouth or lips are drawn. The mouth is a later customization.
There is hair, a braid, or a circlet.
There is a neckband, scarf, hanging cloth, armor, coat, pants, or boots.
The feet are large blocks, slabs, or rectangles instead of feet.
An arm is missing, extra, or fused into the torso.

mannequin-side.about: Strict side of the same clean base body. Feet together, not a walk step.
mannequin-side.allow: One eye in profile may be present. Bare skin and a bald head are correct.

checks.fail_if: There is not exactly one full-body person in a strict side view.
An eyebrow is drawn. Eyebrows are a later customization.
A nose sticks out. The nose is a later customization.
A mouth or lips are drawn. The mouth is a later customization.
There is hair, a braid, or a circlet.
There is a neckband, scarf, hanging cloth, armor, coat, pants, or boots.
The feet are a walk step, or a large block, slab, or rectangle instead of a foot.
An arm is missing, extra, or fused into the torso.

mannequin-back.about: Strict back of the same clean base body. No face and no hanging cloth.
mannequin-back.allow: A bald back of the head and bare skin are correct.

checks.fail_if: There is not exactly one full-body person seen from the back.
A face, eyes, eyebrows, a nose, or a mouth is visible.
There is hair, a braid, or a circlet.
There is a neckband, scarf, hanging cloth, armor, coat, pants, or boots. Cloth hanging down the back fails.
The feet are large blocks, slabs, or rectangles instead of feet.
An arm is missing, extra, or fused into the torso.

mannequin-mesh.about: A render of the 3D base body. Same rules as the front still. Eyes may stay. Eyebrows, the nose, and the mouth must not be modeled.
mannequin-mesh.allow: Eyes may be present. Low-poly facets are allowed. A bald head and bare skin are correct.

checks.fail_if: There is not exactly one full-body person, upright, facing the camera.
Eyebrows are modeled or painted. Eyebrows are a later customization.
A nose is modeled or painted. The nose is a later customization.
A mouth or lips are modeled or painted. The mouth is a later customization.
There is hair, a braid, or a circlet.
There is a neckband, scarf, hanging cloth, armor, coat, pants, or boots.
The feet are large blocks, slabs, or rectangles instead of feet.
An arm is missing, extra, or fused into the torso.
